Home.title: Patient care starts with a secure, clear session.
Home.body: The web experience is built against Nabd Plus contracts. Medicines, bookings and coverage are shown only when authorized backend data is available.
Home.safeBody: This foundation separates private data from public content and keeps session tokens out of browser storage.
Home.safetyThree: No synthetic patient or catalog data

Login.title: Patient sign in
Login.body: Credentials are sent through a protected server layer. Tokens are not stored in localStorage.
Login.twoFactorInvalid: The verification code was not accepted. Try again.
Login.twoFactorUnavailable: Verification service is unavailable. No session was created.
Login.sandboxNote: Use isolated Sandbox accounts only while testing. Do not enter real patient data in this environment.
Login.invalid: Unable to sign in. Review your details and retry.
Login.unavailable: The service could not be reached. No local fallback session was created.
Login.twoFactor: This session requires additional verification. The verification form will be enabled after its Sandbox DTO is verified.

Dashboard.title: Patient session is protected.
Dashboard.body: Links are available for features that passed their contract and authorization checks. No data is shown before it comes from the authorized backend.

Orders.title: My orders
Orders.empty: There are currently no orders available for this account.
Orders.detailNotice: These details are displayed only from the authorized backend.
Orders.unavailableBody: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.

Cart.title: My cart
Cart.notice: Cart contents and totals are read directly from the authorized backend. No checkout or payment is performed here.
Cart.unavailableBody: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.

Appointments.title: My appointments
Appointments.empty: There are currently no appointments available for this account.
Appointments.detailNotice: Appointment details are displayed only from the authorized backend. Static or synthetic waiting data is not shown.
Appointments.unavailableBody: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.

Medicines.title: Medicines
Medicines.searchLabel: Search by name or active ingredient
Medicines.empty: No medicines match the current search.
Medicines.detailNotice: This is catalog information from the authorized backend, not a prescription or treatment recommendation. Consult a qualified professional when needed.
Medicines.unavailableBody: No fallback data or price was shown. Please retry later.

Diagnostics.title: Diagnostic bookings
Diagnostics.empty: There are currently no diagnostic bookings available.
Diagnostics.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this section.
Diagnostics.unavailable: This section could not be loaded. No fallback data was shown.
Diagnostics.detailNotice: Only booking status and schedule are displayed from the authorized backend. Reports, documents, and pricing are not displayed in this interface.

HomeCare.title: Home-care bookings
HomeCare.empty: There are currently no home-care bookings available.
HomeCare.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
HomeCare.notice: Only service, booking status, and schedule are shown. Location, tracking, clinical information, and pricing are not displayed in this interface.

Family.title: Family members
Family.empty: There are currently no family members available.
Family.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Family.notice: Only member role and join date are displayed. Identifiers, permissions, health records, and invitations are not displayed in this interface.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.empty: There are currently no notifications available.
Notifications.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Notifications.notice: This is a read-only list. No payload links, read-marking action, device registration, or settings operation is performed from this interface.

Health.title: Vital summary
Health.empty: There are currently no vital readings available.
Health.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Health.notice: This section displays recorded readings only and does not provide a diagnosis, alert, or treatment recommendation. Consult a qualified professional for medical care.
Health.scoreNotice: This is a recorded wellness summary, not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
Health.reportsNotice: Recorded report metadata only is shown. Report body and attachments remain protected.
Health.vitalsHistoryNotice: This read-only view shows readings saved to your patient record. It does not calculate a diagnosis or medical judgment.
Health.vitalsHistoryNoDefaults: No default values or synthetic trends are shown.
Health.vitalsHistoryReadOnly: Adding, editing, and deleting readings remain unavailable until replay-safe mutation contracts are verified.

Prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
Prescriptions.empty: There are currently no prescriptions available.
Prescriptions.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Prescriptions.notice: Prescription state, item count, date, doctor name, and medication names may be shown from the authorized patient record. Doses, diagnoses, files, dispensing, and sending operations are not exposed in this interface.
Prescriptions.detailNotice: Only medication details returned by the authorized backend are shown. Diagnosis, upload, renewal, dispensing, and order actions are not available.
Prescriptions.contractPending: Blocked pending an authorized prescription-detail contract.

Chat.title: Chats
Chat.empty: There are currently no chats available.
Chat.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Chat.notice: Only limited chat metadata is shown. Participant names, message previews, and attachments are not displayed, and this interface cannot open chats, send messages, or update delivery or read state.

Reminders.title: Medication reminders
Reminders.empty: There are currently no medication reminders available.
Reminders.unavailable: No fallback data was shown. Please retry later.
Reminders.notice: Only recorded reminders are displayed. This interface creates no local alert or schedule and does not log a dose, snooze a reminder, or request a refill. This information is not medical advice.

Profile.title: My health profile
Profile.body: Only fields available from the authorized backend are displayed. No local values are created when data is absent.
Profile.empty: No data is available to display.
Profile.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this section.
Profile.unavailable: This section could not be loaded. No fallback data was shown.

Metadata.publicDescription: Nabd Plus public patient portal and medicine information catalogue.

PublicMedicines.title: Published catalogue
PublicMedicines.body: Browse published catalogue information only. This page does not classify every entry as a medicine and does not provide a prescription, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, pricing, or availability guarantee.
PublicMedicines.searchLabel: Search by name or active ingredient
PublicMedicines.empty: No published catalogue entries match the current search.
PublicMedicines.detailNotice: This is published catalogue information, not a prescription or treatment recommendation. Consult a qualified professional when needed.
PublicMedicines.notice: No price, purchase, prescription, booking, patient, or insurance information is displayed in this public catalogue. It remains out of search indexing until the backend supplies a verified medicine classification.
PublicMedicines.unavailable: Published information is temporarily unavailable. No substitute data was shown.

NotFound.title: Page unavailable
NotFound.body: This route cannot be opened or you do not have permission to access it.

RouteState.loadingBody: No fallback data is shown while the authorized response is pending.
RouteState.errorTitle: The page cannot be opened now
RouteState.errorBody: No fallback data or technical detail has been shown. Try again, or return home if the issue continues.

Insurance.title: Insurance overview
Insurance.notice: Only the limited policy summary returned by the server is shown. Policy numbers, member identifiers, card files, claims and payments are not displayed here.
Insurance.unavailable: No fallback insurance data was shown. Please retry later.
Insurance.claimsNotice: Only the server-provided service, status, and date are shown. Amounts, identifiers, documents, and payment actions remain hidden.
Insurance.claimsEmpty: No claims were returned by the server.

MentalHealth.title: Wellbeing dashboard
MentalHealth.notice: These descriptive self-reported statistics are not a diagnosis, risk score, or treatment recommendation.
MentalHealth.unavailable: No fallback wellbeing data was shown. Please retry later.
MentalHealth.crisisNotice: Only owner-scoped contact metadata is shown. Phone numbers are masked and calling, adding, or deleting contacts is not available in this read-only view.
MentalHealth.crisisEmpty: No crisis contacts were returned for this account.
MentalHealth.breathingNotice: This read-only view shows sessions returned by the authorized backend. Starting or logging a new session is not available here.
MentalHealth.moodHistoryNotice: This read-only view shows self-reported mood entries for the last 30 days. Notes, tags, journaling, and diagnosis are not shown or generated.
MentalHealth.meditationHistoryNotice: This read-only view shows recorded mindfulness practice sessions. It does not create sessions or make treatment claims.

Settings.title: Privacy and security
Settings.notice: These values are read from your account. This page is read-only until secure update contracts are closed.
Settings.readOnlyBoundary: No privacy, security, password, session, export, or deletion action is performed here.
Settings.unavailable: No fallback settings data was shown.
Settings.sessionsSummary: Showing the first {shown} of {total} active sessions.

NotificationSettings.title: Notification settings
NotificationSettings.notice: These values come from your current account settings. This page is read-only until secure update contracts are closed.

descriptions.emergency: Critical safety and health emergency alerts
descriptions.sound: Play a sound when notifications arrive

Articles.title: Health articles
Articles.notice: Published article metadata and excerpts are shown only when returned by the public backend.
Articles.bookmarksNotice: Your saved articles are loaded from your account. Bookmark changes remain unavailable until the write contract is verified.
Articles.bodyHidden: The article body is not displayed in this read-only slice because the sanitized content and media contract is not yet verified.
Articles.unavailable: No fallback article data was shown.

ChatDetail.bodyHidden: Message bodies, participant identifiers, reactions, and attachments remain hidden in this read-only slice until the protected-content contract is verified.
ChatDetail.attachmentHidden: An attachment is present; its protected URL is not shown.
ChatDetail.unavailable: No fallback conversation data was shown.

Sleep.title: Sleep readings
Sleep.notice: This read-only surface shows persisted sleep metrics only; adding, editing, deleting, and clinical recommendations are not available.
Sleep.unavailable: No fallback sleep data was shown.

EmergencyContacts.title: Emergency contacts
EmergencyContacts.notice: Phone numbers are masked. Adding and deleting contacts remain unavailable until the mutation contract is verified.
EmergencyContacts.unavailable: No fallback contact data was shown.

ChronicDiseases.title: Chronic conditions
ChronicDiseases.notice: These are self-recorded profile entries only. No diagnosis, severity, control assessment, or treatment recommendation is provided.
ChronicDiseases.unavailable: No fallback condition data was shown.

ChronicMedications.title: Chronic medications
ChronicMedications.notice: This surface shows recorded medication schedules and refill metadata only. Add, edit, stop, refill, and reminder actions remain unavailable.
ChronicMedications.unavailable: No fallback medication data was shown.

HealthTrends.title: Health trends
HealthTrends.notice: This read-only view summarizes recorded readings and direction only. It is not a diagnosis, alert, normal-range assessment, or treatment recommendation.
HealthTrends.unavailable: No fallback trend data was shown.

Specialties.title: Medical specialties
Specialties.subtitle: Choose a specialty to continue to available doctors. Results come from the authorized service only.
Specialties.unavailableBody: No fallback or sample data was shown. Please try again later.
Specialties.emptyBody: No specialties are currently available from the authorized service.

HomeCareServices.title: Home-care services
HomeCareServices.subtitle: Browse services from the authorized source. We do not show prices or services absent from the response.
HomeCareServices.unavailableBody: No fallback or sample data was shown. Please try again later.
HomeCareServices.emptyBody: No services are currently available from the authorized source.
HomeCareServices.bookingNotice: Service details are read-only here. No booking is created from this page.
